findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed no sanitizer solution to be prepared upon arrival. Discussed with PIC, sanitizer bucket was made and tested at 100 ppm CL. Ensure a sanitzer solution is available during all hours of operation.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (A) A chlorine solution shall have a minimum temperature based on the concentration and PH of the solution as listed in the chart in 4-501.114 (A).

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Observed microwave to be soiled with food splash debris. Discussed with PIC, microwave was cleaned with a sanitizer rag. Ensure non food contact surfaces are being cleaned at a frequency that prevents any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Observed mold accumulation to be present at the wall behind soda dispensing nozzles. Discussed with PIC, area will be cleaned. Ensure non food contact areas are being cleaned at a frequency that prevent mold accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.comment:
2-103.11: (O) FOOD EMPLOYEES are informed in verifiable manner of their responsibility to report accordance with LAW, to PIC, information about their health related to disease transmissible through FOOD.  

On arrival, no reporting agreements are observable at the facility. Inspector discussed with the PIC and gave them copies of the Reporting Agreements distributed by this department. As only a couple food handlers are needed at the facility, the agreements could be signed today.

findings.title: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events
findings.comment:
2-501.11: A FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall have written procedures for EMPLOYEES to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the FOOD ESTABLISHMENT. The procedures shall address the specific actions EMPLOYEES must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of EMPLOYEES, consumers, FOOD, and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter.

On arrival, the chemical intended for disinfecting a surface after cleaning of vomit/ diarrhea was not sufficient for Norovirus. A procedure retrieved from the CDC was given to the PIC during the inspection as they already have bleach in the facility.

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used
findings.comment:
7-204.11: (A)-(B): Chemical SANITIZERS applied for FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall meet regulatory requirements. 

On arrival, the spray bottle used for spraying the counters bleached out the CL test strip used to check its concentration. PIC was consulted and the bottle remade to correct. Inspector discussed the hazards for chemicals at to high of a concentration being used near foods/ food contact surfaces.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
2-102.12: (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM. 

On arrival, the only CFPM employed at the facility had already gone home for the day. Inspector discussed with the current PIC and explained that the facility needs a CFPM on site at all times that foods are being handled. The CFPM arrived during the inspection to correct.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

Observed general debris under the shelves in the walk in cooler and under the soda boxes that feed into the soda machine from dry storage. Discussed with the PIC and instructed to clean often enough so as to prevent accumulation.

findings.title: Wholesome, sound condition
findings.comment: 750-100 Food shall be in sound condition, free from spoilage, filth, and other contamination and shall be safe for human consumption. Observed several containers of single serving milks tat were beyond the acceptable limit for use. Several instances with date ranging from March through July. When discussing it, the person in charge began pulling the products out of compliance to send back to the distributer.

findings.title: Water source safe, hot, and cooled under pressure
findings.comment: 750-1030 Water under pressure at the required temperature shall be provided to all fixtures and equipment that use water. Observed no hot water out of the faucets at the establishment. When asked, the person in charge stated that the water heater had gone out and they had another already ordered.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment: Refer to previous routine inspection.

findings.title: Approved source
findings.comment:
Facility is operating under a high risk facility. Fast Stop is cooling and reheating Italian beef and pulled pork. Spoke with manager about the issue and he stated he will talk with management about if they want to upgrade to a high risk facility.
750-100 Food shall be obtained from sources that comply with all laws relating to food and food labeling.  The use of home prepared or home canned foods is strictly prohibited.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment:
Observed a wet wiping cloth stored on the counter top. No sanitizer solution was made for the day. If cooking and preparing food, there must be a sanitizer bucket where cloths can be stored in between uses.
750-810b Moist cloths used for wiping food spills on kitchenware and food-contact surfaces shall be clean and rinsed frequently in one of the permitted sanitizing solutions. See Section 750.820e.   These cloths shall be stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses.

findings.title: Outer openings protected from insects, rodent proof
findings.comment: Observed a gap at the side door. Replace the door sweep. Outer openings shall be tight fitting and self closing.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
1) Observed around the floor drain to be soiled. Clean the floor drain. 2) Observed the coving to be coming apart from the wall near the mop closet. Replace coving.
750-1200 The junctures between walls and floors shall be coved and sealed, or shall not present an opening of more that 1/32 of an inch.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
Observed three large holes in the wall near the fishing bait. Walls should be smooth and easily cleanable. Fill holes in the wall.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed the shelf underneath the handwashing sink damaged. Repair the shelf where chemicals are stored.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
1) Observed the coffee spout and the tea spout to be soiled. Clean the food contact surfaces.
750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
Observed a leak under the soda machine that is leaking into a bucket. Repair the leak and dump waste water daily.
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

Observed no lid on the bathroom trash can. Provide a lid.
750-1110d Toilet facilities shall be kept clean and in good repair and free of objectionable odors. A supply of toilet tissue shall be provided at each toilet at all times. Easily cleanable, covered receptacles shall be provided for waste materials.

findings.comment:
Observed the drain under the three compartment sink to be soiled. Clean the floor drain.
750-1200 All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.

750-1390 Maintenance and cleaning tools such as brooms, mops, vacuum cleaners and similar equipment shall be maintained and stored in a way that does not contaminate food.
